subject: POC trial plan & owner roster — next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial plan & owner roster — next steps

Hi Elaine / team —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment going into the POC: 

1) High-level POC objective
- Validate Redwood Inference can serve your customer-facing recommendation model at ~120 reqs/s with 95th pct latency <250ms for 512-token responses, and integrate with your app via our hosted API.

2) Success criteria (we'll map these into the spreadsheet attached)
- Latency: 95th percentile under 250ms at target QPS for 2-3 minute sustained windows.
- Accuracy/regression: model output similarity score within 3% of your baseline on the provided evaluation set.
- Cost target: projected cost per 1M tokens below your internal threshold (we'll run cost modeling).
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate during test windows, and automatic fallback to a smaller model if capacity is constrained.

3) Evaluation plan & timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope + access & infra prerequisites.
- Week 1: connect workloads, upload evaluation set, run smoke tests.
- Week 2: 48–72 hour sustained load tests + regression checks.
- Week 3: review results, tuning recommendations, and finalize handoff to engineering.

4) Ownership / quick RACI (proposed, please confirm):
- App integration (API calls, SDK): R = CloudCraft app team (Elaine), A = Marissa Cole (Redwood solutions), C = Karthik, I = Soojin
- Infra & networking (VPC, firewall, egress rules): R = Karthik Iyer (Redwood infra lead), A = Elaine (CloudCraft infra lead), C = Grace O'Connor (security), I = Marissa
- Security & compliance evidence (SOC2, data residency): R = Grace O'Connor (Redwood sec), A = CloudCraft security (Rajiv), C = Karthik, I = Soojin
- Procurement / SOW & signatures: R = Marissa Cole (Redwood sales ops), A = Elaine (CloudCraft procurement), C = Soojin, I = Karthik

5) Immediate asks for CloudCraft (please reply in-line):
- Confirm security contact (name + email) and whether you require on-premise or VPC-only deployment for the POC.
- Share the evaluation dataset (sample) and any rate-limit or IP allowlist requirements.
- Procurement window: confirm if you need a PO or can sign an SOW (and expected timing).

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet with the success metric rows), Network_Requirements.pdf (initial ask list).

If that looks good I'll update the Google folder and create the shared runbook with test windows. Happy to hop on a 20-minute sync if you'd rather walk through the proposed timeline.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform for production ML

Thanks Soojin — solid recap, appreciate the clear owners. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Security contact: Rajiv Mehta (rajiv.mehta@cloudcraft.com) — he'll need the SOC2 report and a short questionnaire on data handling.
- Data residency: we need the test traffic to originate from our US region; VPC peering is preferred. Can your hosted API be restricted to only our IP ranges during the POC?
- Procurement: we can sign an SOW, but legal wants a copy of the standard data processing addendum (DPA). Our procurement lead expects to approve within 3 weeks once the SOW is in our system.

We'll upload the eval dataset (anonymized) to the Drive link you provided by EOD Monday. Also happy to accept the POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx — I'll ask our PM to add a couple of business KPIs.

If you can confirm who on Redwood will be our day-to-day technical contact for infra/networking (for firewall rules, ip ranges, and test windows), that would help Rajiv and our infra team.

Best,
Elaine
VP Product, CloudCraft Inc.
